Appearance

Willowy half-elf with silver-streaked dark hair and violet eyes. Wears deep blue robes trimmed with lunar motifs. Moves with deliberate grace.

What We Know

Long-serving advisor to King Alaric. Respected for her wisdom and breadth of knowledge. Maintains a private study in the palace's east tower.

First Impressions

Speaks softly and chooses words with obvious care — every sentence feels measured.
